collections/deque#

An immutable persistent double-ended queue.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let queue = Deque(values: jobs);
let urgent = queue.prefix(high_priority);
let ordinary = urgent.suffix(low_priority);
let next = ordinary.first();
let remaining = ordinary.tail();

Description#

An immutable persistent double-ended queue.

first() and last() read the ends; prefix(x) and suffix(x) add at the front and the back; tail() drops the first item and body() the last. Each returns a new deque: earlier deques stay unchanged and may share immutable list nodes with their successors. The ends of an empty deque throw EmptyDequeAccess. item(index) gives Python-style indexing with strict zero-based bounds (OutOfRange); middle indexing is O(n).

Internally the logical order is a forward list followed by the reverse of a backward list. End additions are O(1). When one half grows beyond roughly twice the other, construction of the returned deque rebalances both halves in O(n); along a linear chain of returned deques, end operations are amortized O(1). Traversal preserves insertion order.
